title: FULL OUTER JOIN Employees and Departments
description: Combine Employees and Departments using FULL OUTER JOIN to find unmatched rows on both sides.

data.text: Write a query that returns all employees and all departments, showing NULL for non-matching sides.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT
    e.EmployeeID,
    e.EmployeeName,
    d.DepartmentID,
    d.DepartmentName
FROM Employees e
FULL OUTER JOIN Departments d ON e.DepartmentID = d.DepartmentID
ORDER BY e.EmployeeName, d.DepartmentName;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: FULL OUTER JOIN returns all rows from both tables. If there is no match, the other side is NULL. This is useful for finding orphaned records — rows in Employees with no Department or rows in Departments with no Employees.
